subject: [hw] DONE V33 rev 6
body:
Rev 6: one added test binary, no shim code change. The main suite links without V32, so its weak n2shim_thread_request_stop is NULL there and the "stop every cpu" half of exit/abort/__stack_chk_fail was untested. The new t_hook.c supplies a strong stand-in and checks that each of the three fatal calls invokes it exactly once (and sets the calling cpu stop_request and the reason).

  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v33/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V33-TABLE PASS 27/27
    N2TEST V33-HOOK PASS 10/10
    N2TEST V33 PASS 309/309   (ASan+UBSan -O1)
    N2TEST V33 PASS 309/309   (plain -O2)
    N2TEST V33 PASS 309/309   (TSan -O1)

Last line unchanged: N2TEST V33 PASS 309/309. Runtime 17 s idle / 80 s loaded. Everything else from rev 2-5 stands; no V33 findings open; V30 F15 has my patch proposal and is not mine.
